content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"No—the human reporter said I was not with them for the lesson.","support":[14],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The reporter met Neri Sol at the old ferry shed.","support":[14],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"They thought the encounter happened sometime in early September, but were unsure.","support":[14],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"I received their report through my mobile body on 2026-09-12.","support":[14],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"Neri showed the reporter how to patch a canvas cover using waxed thread.","support":[14],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The reporter appreciated Neri's patient explanation and wanted to share the encounter with me.","support":[14],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"As of that report, the reporter had not tried the method.","support":[14],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Neri gave the reporter no handle or surname beyond Sol.","support":[14],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not record a later attempt together.","support":[14],"basis":"unknown","facet":"limits"}]}
